tasks.title: Website Tutorial
tasks.description:
Welcome to the tutorial! This is a task that you can use to practice coding websites with our AI assistant.

Try adding the following features manually or with the AI assistant to get more familiar with our interface:

  • Change the heading text to say 'I love vibe coding'
  • Make the button blue
  • Change the alert message to say a joke.
  • Add an animated shape somewhere on the page.

Once you're done, click on the Submit / Finish Tutorial button to finish the tutorial. You'll add a project title + description and answer some questions, then you can move on to the main website tasks.

Note: If you refresh the page, your changes will be lost. This is not the case for the other tasks you will be completing: your work will be saved automatically.
